text_block_list.name: Messiah's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Here you go, Messiah.
This is the training notebook you wanted to
see.
It's full of my old notes,
but... are you sure this is okay?

text_block_list.name: Young Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Wow...! Thank you, Mother!
I promise to cherish and read every single
word!

text_block_list.name: Young Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to work super hard!
More than anyone!
And then, someday—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Someday, I'll be just like you, Mother.

text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Oh, there you are! Finally found ya~! Hey,
all us rookie trainers
are heading out for yakiniku to talk shop,
wanna come along?
choice_data_list: Ah... sorry. I haven't finished my...

text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Huh? But your assignment for today was...
whoa!
You wrote out the equipment check report in
this much detail...?!
choice_data_list: Well, I just covered everything li...

text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, I asked the senior trainers,
and they said keeping it brief is fine!
Come on, yakiniku!
That rookie who scouted someone yesterday
is coming too!
choice_data_list: ...Sorry. I still have other work ...

text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Ah... I see. Sorry for pushing you so hard,
then!
I'll invite you again sometime.
Don't overdo it, okay? See ya~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After finishing up work,
I return to my room in the trainer dorms...
and let out a deep sigh.
The incident in the gym storage room crosses
my mind. ...I messed up again.
choice_data_list: "Being overly earnest is your only...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Never in my life have I managed to do things
cleverly or effortlessly.
I lack quick wit, my ideas are plain,
and I can only ever offer play-it-safe
proposals.
choice_data_list: (Which is why every girl I try to ...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And yet,
since "being overly earnest is my only
redeeming quality"—

text_block_list.name: Instructor A
text_block_list.text:
Let's see... Alright,
everyone in our group is here.
Let's get started! First,
head down to the beach! ...Wait, whoa!?

text_block_list.name: Instructor A
text_block_list.text:
Are you...
a rookie trainer without an assigned trainee?
W-Well, that's rare.
It's boiling hot, tough work,
and you just get saddled with chores,
so barely anyone comes.
choice_data_list: No... well, I'll do my best with t...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Taking the phrase "Rookie trainer participation
recommended" completely literally,
I ended up coming all the way to summer
training camp. I sigh at myself again.

text_block_list.name: Instructor A
text_block_list.text:
—Alright, that's it for today!
You're free until dinner.
Everyone,
make sure you stay hydrated and replenish
your electrolytes!
choice_data_list: If anyone needs drinks, I have the...

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text:
Wah! Thank you so much~!
...Hey,
what are you doing after this?
Are we going to that nearby mall after
all!?

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl B
text_block_list.text:
Totally!
This brutal training camp has barely even
started, after all.
Refreshing ourselves is super important♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so,
most of the girls headed off to take a
break.
...However—

choice_data_list: ...She's the only one still traini...

text_block_list.name: Instructor A
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Air Messiah.
She did mention wanting to add more
core training to improve her running form,
but—

text_block_list.name: Instructor A
text_block_list.text:
Core workouts are plain and simple,
yet brutally exhausting, right?
For her to quietly devote herself like that
is truly admirable.
choice_data_list: Yes... She really is a diligent girl.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...In the distance,
the cheerful voices of girls playing on the
beach echo out. Amidst that,
the sight of her sweating away alone in
silence left a deep impression on me.

text_block_list.name: Cafeteria Uncle
text_block_list.text:
All right,
another rice cooker coming through!
If anyone wants seconds, step right up!
Eat hearty to prepare for tomorrow! Hey,
you over there, young lady, you too!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
No, thank you.
I have already eaten as much as I require.
It was truly delicious, sir.

text_block_list.name: Cafeteria Uncle
text_block_list.text:
Gahaha!
Calling me 'sir' tickles me in all the right
ways! Ah~ come to think of it,
someone used to call me that before... Wait,
huh? Whaaat!?

text_block_list.name: Cafeteria Uncle
text_block_list.text:
Could it be?! Little lady,
was your mother a Tracen Academy student
back in the day?!
The famous one who tore up the Triple Tiara
circuit...!
choice_data_list: (! ...That girl's... mother?)

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
My... you know of my mother.
Yes, I am her daughter, Air Messiah.

text_block_list.name: Cafeteria Uncle
text_block_list.text:
I knew it~! Wow,
so her kid is already this grown up!
Time sure flies...
Give it your all just like your mama,
I'm rooting for ya!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I shall do my best.
Now then... if you will excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Air Messiah takes her leave.
Watching her depart,
I decide to take a chance
and ask the cook about what he just said.
choice_data_list: Excuse me... could you tell me mor...

text_block_list.name: Cafeteria Uncle
text_block_list.text:
Hm? ...Oh, about her mother? Man,
they look so alike. Total spitting image.
Especially that serious aura of hers.

text_block_list.name: Cafeteria Uncle
text_block_list.text:
Little Miss Messiah must be quite the hard
worker too, right?
Her mother was the exact same way.
I remember it clear as day.

text_block_list.name: Cafeteria Uncle
text_block_list.text:
During training camp, day in and day out,
she'd be covered in sweat and mud.
Always striving,
putting in effort after effort...
It was truly humbling to see.

text_block_list.name: Cafeteria Uncle
text_block_list.text:
And once she debuted,
she actually ran in all the Triple Tiara
races!
Incredible, right? All three: the Oka Sho,
the Yushun Himba, and the Shuka Sho!

text_block_list.name: Cafeteria Uncle
text_block_list.text:
...But,
you know.
She came so agonizingly close in every single
one.
choice_data_list: Agonizingly close...?

text_block_list.name: Cafeteria Uncle
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. She took 3rd in the Oka Sho,
2nd in the Yushun Himba,
and 3rd in the Shuka Sho,
if memory serves. In the end,
she never grasped a GⅠ crown...
It must've been heartbreaking.
choice_data_list: And that daughter... is Air Messiah.

text_block_list.name: Cafeteria Uncle
text_block_list.text:
That's how it is. ...Man, but still...
Thinking back on it now,
she really does take after her mother.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Early the next morning.
When I head down to the beach to prepare
for training...
choice_data_list: Huh? That girl...!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa, whew...! 
Just... five more kilometers...!
choice_data_list: (Today, she's doing beach sprints...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Running on unstable sand is certainly
effective for building core strength.
According to her assigned instructor,
her goal is to improve her form through core
training.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Because it must be done,
I shall do it." In the chilly early morning
air,
steam practically rises from her sweat-drenched
body.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa...! Haa, haa, haa...
—Phew.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
How long, and how far,
had she been running?
...As the thought crossed my mind,
I found myself calling out to her.
choice_data_list: ...Great work out here.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Eh?
Ah... yes.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Are you... someone's trainer?
choice_data_list: No, I'm still a rookie... just her...
No, I'm still a rookie... just her...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Oh, is that so?
Thank you for your hard work as well,
being up so early in the morning.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Am I perhaps getting in the way
of your work by running here?
choice_data_list: Ah, no, not at all!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
That is a relief. ...Well then,
I shall resume running.
Please excuse me.
choice_data_list: Right. ...Um, keep it up!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Yes. I will give it my all. —Goodbye.
